unit.title: Time
unit.blurb: Days of the week, ordering events, and telling the time to the hour and half hour.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Know the days of the week and put events in order.

O2.t: Read o'clock and half past times on a clock.

p: There are **7 days** in a week: **Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday**. Then Monday comes again.
We do things in order: **first** we wake up, **next** we eat breakfast, **then** we go to school, and **last** we go to bed.

p: A clock has a **short hand** for the hour and a **long hand** for the minutes. When the long hand points to **12**, it is **o'clock**.
When the long hand points to **6**, it has gone half way round: it is **half past**. The short hand is half way between two numbers.
The short hand tells the hour. The long hand tells the minutes. Do not mix them up.

options.fb: Look at the short hand again.
The short hand shows the hour: 3.
The long hand points to 6, not 12.
